text:
Maya (Sales): FinCo RFP arrived this AM. Must-haves: per-tenant capacity controls, latency-tier routing, 99.9% inference availability. They want a pilot timeline for procurement.

Ava (PM): Sales needs a yes/no on committing to a pilot timeline by EOD tomorrow.

Raj (Eng): We can do a scoped pilot. Hardened product ~7-9w. Minimum pilot (shim) ~4w: soft caps + routing shim + audit events + manual rollback.

Liam (SE): Pilot acceptance proposal:
- Soft per-tenant GPU caps + alerts
- Two latency tiers (low/standard) + deterministic fallback
- Routing/model selection audit logs
- Customer-facing risk doc & manual rollback
Keep autoscale and advanced batching out.

Priya (CS): Compliance note: if physical isolation can't be guaranteed, we must provide SOC2 control mapping + signed risk acknowledgment. CS will own runbook.

Noah (Design): UI: simple console toggle for caps and latency selector. I'll deliver low-fi mock for pilot.

Jordan (CTO): Is this a one-off or platform signal? If we prioritize, what do we deprioritize?

Ava (PM): It's both. Proposal: greenlight scoped pilot and postpone the optics/eval sprint by one cadence to free 2 engineers for ~5w.

Raj (Eng): +1 if we reassign two ICs and get Eng-SRE support for canary/autoscale tests. Need a clear canary -> single-tenant prod -> ramp plan and fallback to single-model routing.

Maya (Sales): If we can commit to an 8-week pilot window with canary & rollback plan, I can push for an LOI. Pricing is secondary; reliability matters.

Priya (CS): Add runbook acceptance: failover steps, compliance checklist, and tenant-load test harness. I'll draft runbook by Friday.

Liam (SE): I'll build the load harness and share a route policy snippet:
route_policy:
  - low: max_p95_ms=60 -> fallback=standard
  - standard: max_p95_ms=300

Noah (Design): Mock uploaded (low-fi). Linking in the pilot doc once PR merges.

Jordan (CTO): Conditional go: greenlight if Eng + PM sign timeline and we produce a customer risk doc. Otherwise push to next quarter.

Ava (PM): Quick vote to greenlight pilot + pause eval sprint?

Raj (Eng): +1 (with Eng-SRE sign-off).

Maya (Sales): +1. I'll give FinCo an 8-week pilot timeline conditional on the risk doc.

Priya (CS): +1. Runbook and checklist by Friday COB.

Liam (SE): +1. Test harness ready for SRE canary tests.

Ava (PM): Next steps:
- Raj: confirm resource reassignments & SRE support by EOD
- Noah: attach mockups here
- Priya + Liam: pair on runbook + load tests
- Maya: request LOI with conditional 8-week pilot

deploy-bot: Pipeline created for branch feat/tenant-cap-shim. No prod deploy until canary gates pass.

Ava (PM): We'll reconvene tomorrow 9:30am PT to finalize the customer-facing pilot doc. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
